flows:
Navigate to https://www.federalreserve.gov/ then Work exclusively inside the Reading view dialog.
Use only its listed roles, names and controls.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
If a CAPTCHA or access challenge appears, @v16:"stop and report it".
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
In Reading view, first assert a News and Events or Press Releases link row is present, or assert the site search textbox is present.
Activate News and Events or Press Releases and verify a list of public releases is visible.

summary:
Opened the Reading view on the Federal Reserve public website as requested.
Selected the Press Releases section using the controls available in Reading view.
A list of public press releases was displayed, including the College Fed Challenge winners announcement and a senior financial officers survey release.
